summary: Phase 4 (Jasmine and Auntie Fong playable, ribbon, parade finale) tested on backend and frontend, plus a Wing regression. Backend: 69 of 71 pytest passed (new file test_phase4_owners.py plus the earlier suites). The 2 failures are the same real bug: 2 fallback lines have no Cantonese word. Frontend: JRN-72 and JRN-76 to JRN-88 PASS in the UI. Wing still scores 3 stars end to end, mic simulate sends, TTS falls back to text-only, and there were no console errors.

minor.endpoint: POST /api/dialogue (fallback, JRN-73/74 'every reply contains a Cantonese word')
minor.issue: 2 fallback lines have no Cantonese word. owners_p4.JASMINE.fallback.budget[1] is 'Like, HK$1500 max, ok? Gotta keep it real.' (served when the turn index is odd). owners_p4.FONG.fallback.goal[0] is "It's our 20th anniversary, dear! I want a traditional congratulation stand with a ribbon, and flowers that last a week." (served on turn 0, which is what the initial chip 'What's the occasion, Auntie?' gets). The LLM path adds 'Hai, ' to replies through validate(), but fallback_turn does not. Fix: add a Cantonese word to both lines, or apply the same 'Hai, ' guard inside fallback_turn.
Info only: 1 of about 8 live Jasmine calls hit the 3.9 s LLM timeout and used the fallback (latency 3902 ms). The fallback was still correct (budget revealed). The other live calls took 2.6 to 3.3 s.

issues: The firework particles show as square points (pointsMaterial has no round sprite or alphaMap), so the bursts look like pixel confetti. Optional: use a round sprite texture.

action_items: Add a Cantonese word to owners_p4 JASMINE fallback.budget[1] and FONG fallback.goal[0], or apply the Cantonese guard (the 'Hai, ' prefix) in dialogue.fallback_turn as validate() already does.
critical_code_review_comments: store.completeTrucks hook: it replaces the levels of the listed non-active owners with freshLevel (the conversation and needs are lost). This is fine for a test hook, but it means JRN-83 checks of the notebook for an owner completed by the hook show empty needs.
The finale auto-ends after FINALE_MS=14 s (director.js). When the screen is slow, a Skip click can arrive after the parade has ended. This is expected; noted for test writers.

clickSlot: the /api/ribbon call has no loading state. If the brace starts before the ribbon returns (about 2 s live), the score is sent with ribbon=null and receipt-ribbon is missing. Consider awaiting the ribbon in beginReveal, or using the owner's ribbon_fallback when it is null.

Jasmine's taboo_ids include 'stand', so placing the stand on Jasmine's truck also fires a /api/ribbon LLM call that is not needed. It does no harm, but the call could be skipped for non-Fong owners if wanted.
The intel cache key now includes owner_id (the iteration 3 minor issue is fixed). The offline festival card is chosen by date (JRN-88 fixed).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_fache_api.py (test_non_playable_404 now uses owner 'nobody', because fong is playable in Phase 4)

rca of the issue: Cantonese word missing: dialogue.validate() adds 'Hai, ' when an LLM reply has no CANTONESE match, but fallback_turn() returns the authored lines exactly as written, and 2 of the new Phase 4 lines have no word from the CANTONESE regex. Reproduction: POST /api/dialogue with X-Force-Fallback: 1 and {owner_id: 'fong', message: "What's the occasion, Auntie?", history: []}, or {owner_id: 'jasmine', message: "What's your budget?", history: [one player turn and one owner turn]}.
